description: AIS Signal and Channel Dataset From Tórshavn Harbor and Surrounding Islands (Faroe Islands) (AIS-TSH) is a data set described in the paper "AIS Signal and Channel Dataset From Tórshavn Harbor and Surrounding Islands (Faroe Islands) (AIS-TSH)" in IEEE Data Descriptions (IEEE, 2026), produced by Johannus Kristmundsson, Jakup Svoostein. This dataset provides Automatic Identification System (AIS) messages and per-message radio-frequency metadata captured in Tórshavn Harbor and the surrounding islands (Faroe Islands) over 76 days in 2025. The corpus contains 7.8 million messages from 547 vessels, with detections observed out to approximately 101 NM. Coverage: Torshavn Harbour and nearby islands, Faroe Islands, over 76 days in 2025. The data are held on IEEE DataPort, and the catalogue links the data set first and the paper second; nothing was downloaded, so the file formats and size are not checked. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost: free of charge according to the repository record; the paper's own access terms were not checked. Caveats: written from the paper's abstract and metadata only, so contents, quality and current availability are unchecked and the description may lag the source. It can support maritime traffic monitoring and AIS coverage studies. Related record: the journal-level record for IEEE Data Descriptions.
